item.summary: Marking another significant step towards strengthening India's semiconductor and electronics ecosystem, Union Minister for Railways, Information & Broadcasting, and Electronics & Information Technology, Shri Ashwini Vaishnaw today launched “Semicon 2.0 – Web Application Portal under the Semicon India Programme” for Pillars 2, 3 and 4, followed by the announcement of 12 Approved Applicants…
item.title: Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw Launches Semicon 2.0 Web Application Portal and Announces 12 Approved Applicants under Electronics Components Manufacturing Scheme
